map.以点/线/面地物为中心按给定半径生成缓冲范围。: Generates a buffer zone centred on a point, line, or polygon feature with a given radius.
map.半径与面积关系？: What Is the Relation Between Radius and Area?
map.圆形缓冲面积 A=πr²，与半径平方成正比；半径扩大 n 倍面积扩大 n² 倍。: The circular buffer area A=πr² is proportional to the square of the radius; multiplying the radius by n multiplies the area by n².
map.常用于 GIS 服务半径分析、选址评估、影响范围测算，本质是以地物为中心按半径外: Commonly used for GIS service radius analysis, site selection assessment, and impact range estimation, it is essentially a polygon formed by expanding outward by a radius around a feature.
map.测算施工影响范围或用地退让界线的缓冲带面积。: Compute the buffer zone area for the construction impact range or the land setback boundary.
map.缓冲区有什么用途？: What Is a Buffer Zone Used For?
map.评估设施（站点/基站）的服务半径与覆盖区。: Assess the service radius and coverage area of a facility (a site or a base station).
: For a site with a 500m service radius: buffer circle area ≈ π×500² ≈ 785398 m² ≈ 78.5 ha; doubling the radius to 1000m gives about 314 ha, since area grows with the square of the radius.
map.：道路两侧各退让 15m 的缓冲带，路线长 2km 时带宽面积≈2×15×200: : With a 15m setback on both sides of a road and a route length of 2 km, the buffer area ≈ 2×15×2000 = 60000 m² ≈ 6 ha (endpoints not counted).
